route_title: Asymmetric 34/92nm Seeded 22-Layer Stack with SA→L-BFGS Hybrid Optimization
compilation_rationale: Bounded route compiles a fixed 22-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica. Gradient-based optimization is used per framework solver constraints, replacing the requested multi-stage scheduler. Spectral bands are separated into independent maximize and minimize objectives to prevent cross-band leakage. Thickness bounds cover the initial estimates. Null target fields were replaced with 0.0 to resolve the reported type validation error.
